newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FIORENTINA BEAT BENFICA 2-1 ON AGGREGATE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIORENTINA BEAT BENFICA 2-1 ON AGGREGATE.

text.p: Benfica of Portugal beat Fiorentina of Italy 1-0 (half time 1-0) in a European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final second leg match on Thursday.

Fiorentina - 1-Francesco Toldo; 16-Giulio Falcone, 3-Michele Serena, 4-Giovanni Piacentini, 5-Lorenzo Amoruso, 19-Pasquale Padalino, 2-Daniele Carnesciale, 7-Stefan Schwarz, 9-Gabriel Batistuta, 10-Rui Costa (23-Anselmo Robbiati 70), 8-Francesco Baiano (11-Luis Oliveira 80).

Benfica - 1-Michel Preud'Homme; 14-Marinho, (19-Bruno Caires 77), 3-Jorge Soares, 5-Jorge Bermudez, 17-Pedro Henriques, 2-Tahar El Kalej (20-Ilian Iliev 77), 6-Jamir, 10-Valdo Filho, 15-Paulao (11-Nica Panduru 77), 23-Edgar Pacheco, 8-Joao Pinto.
